basic_info.description: This thoughtfully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers a seamless blend of modern design and urban convenience. As you enter, you'll notice the gleaming wood floors and be pleasantly surprised by the walk-in coat closet. The open layout connects a sun-drenched living room with wood-burning fireplace, spacious dining area, and a remodeled kitchen boasting granite countertops and a suite of stainless-steel appliances. Just off the dining room is the west-facing balcony that enjoys lovely afternoon sun. Both bedrooms are filled with natural light, including a primary suite with an organized walk-in-closet. Additional highlights include a large deeded storage closet located on the same floor, in-unit laundry, and 1 garage parking space with an EV charger. Set within a well-maintained, elevator building, the home also offers access to an enormous, and beautifully landscaped, garden with a BBQ and picnic tables. With a Walk Score of 99 and just steps from vibrant Fillmore Street's shops, cafes, and public transit, this residence presents the perfect opportunity for the discerning buyer seeking elevated living in a premier San Francisco neighborhood. 77 Transit Score - Excellent Transit. 91 Bike Score - Biker's Paradise.
